notablePrerequisites:
Dr Madison Li does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Dr Madison Li.
You have at least five energy counters.
description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers four times.
Resolve all Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Battlesphere dies, Dr Madison Li triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
